title.justification: The title captures the main focus of the paper, which is the development of the MeshDiffusion model for generating 3D meshes using score-based generative modeling techniques.

extractions.description: The paper introduces MeshDiffusion, a diffusion model designed for generating high-quality 3D meshes. The model leverages a deformable tetrahedral grid representation to overcome limitations of previous methods and aims to produce detailed geometric shapes that are useful in applications such as virtual reality and the metaverse. The paper emphasizes the model's performance in generating fine-grained geometric details and its stability during training. Various experiments are conducted, showcasing its capabilities in both unconditional and conditional generation tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on advancements in 3D mesh generation without any direct emphasis on climate or ecological sustainable development. Its applications are primarily in the fields of virtual reality and graphics, not sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: As one of the most challenging tasks in computer vision and graphics, generative modeling of high-quality 3D shapes is of great significance in many applications such as virtual reality and metaverse.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on developments in generative 3D modeling, specifically using diffusion models for mesh generation. This does not directly align with any Sustainable Development Goals focused on climate or ecology.
primary_category.quote: Compared to other 3D representations like voxels and point clouds, meshes are more desirable in practice, because (1) they enable easy and arbitrary manipulation of shapes for relighting and simulation, and (2) they can fully leverage the power of modern graphics pipelines which are mostly optimized for meshes.

primary_sub_category.justification: The innovations and methods discussed do not relate to any specific ecological or climate-related sub-category as defined in the sustainable development hierarchy.
primary_sub_category.quote: We instead aim to generate 3D shapes by directly producing 3D meshes, where surfaces are represented as a graph of triangular or polygon faces.

new_primary_category.justification: There is no direct application or focus on sustainable development themes such as climate or ecology in this paper.
new_primary_category.quote: The paper's focus is technological advancement in 3D mesh generation.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The subcategories involved are related to tech advancements in graphics and modeling, not relevant to sustainable development themes.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: MeshDiffusion produces highly realistic and fine-grained geometric details while being easy and stable to train.
